verdict.rationale: A derivative ecosystem of community replicas, fine-tunes and quantizations is a fair axis for any AI model family, so the story applies. The evidence pack covers only hosted API capabilities, cloud-marketplace availability and community usage opinions. Nothing in it mentions released weights, public-hub derivatives, or attribution of official versus unofficial artifacts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a real derivative ecosystem exists around the model — community replicas, fine-tunes, or quantizations on public hubs — with clear attribution of what is and is not official
